players.product: IC package substrates: CSP (BT) substrates for memory and RF chips in volume, and FC-BGA substrates (Zhuhai and Guangzhou projects) in sampling / small-batch production; also high-layer PCB, HDI and ATE semiconductor test boards

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 4,037.83 million, up 17.86% YoY; net profit attributable RMB 110.51 million (+283.27%); gross margin 20.95%. Semiconductor business (IC package substrates and test boards) revenue RMB 1,328.97 million (+59.92%); IC package substrate revenue RMB 1,208.97 million, up 67.34%, mainly from CSP substrates, at a -0.36% gross margin because the FCBGA substrate project is not yet in volume production. PCB revenue RMB 2,502.55 million (+2.23%).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 4,037.83 million (+17.86%); IC package substrates RMB 1,208.97 million (+67.34%), gross margin -0.36%

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (half-year report): CSP substrate orders are full and utilization is high, helped by the memory-chip recovery and higher share at its main memory customers; the business focuses on memory and RF and is expanding into automotive, shifting toward multilayer and high-difficulty boards. Despite sharp upstream raw-material price rises, it passed costs on through product price increases.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (half-year report): the FCBGA substrate project is ready for volume production in technology, capacity and yield, with yields improving; customer introduction and sample deliveries are proceeding, sample orders rose sharply YoY and the share of high-layer-count, large-size products keeps rising. FCBGA project expenses (labor, depreciation, energy, materials) were RMB 32,937.39 ten-thousand in H1 2026, a large drag on profit; built capacity is ramping. The company will push domestic customers and pursue overseas customers' audits, sampling and volume opportunities.
quarterly_data.figure: FCBGA project expenses RMB 32,937.39 ten-thousand in H1 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (half-year report): the company is developing LPDDR5 ultra-thin boards, high-heat-dissipation PMIC products, glass substrates, high-layer orthogonal backplanes and 3.2T NPO optical module products.
